newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo aluminium futures end lower as yen rises.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo aluminium futures end lower as yen rises.

text.p: Tokyo aluminium futures closed lower on Monday, as the yen's rise against the dollar offset the LME's price gains on Friday, traders said.
TOCOM prices were 0.1 to 0.7 yen lower, with the benchmark February contract down 0.7 yen at 203.5 yen per kg. The day's volume was 2,930 lots.
All contracts moved in narrow ranges throughout the day, amid a lack of clear incentives for local investors, traders said.
"Investors will be sidelined later this week, ahead of the Golden Week holiday season," a brokerage house trader said.
Trade houses were reluctant to conduct arbitrage between TOCOM and the spot market because of low liquidity in futures, traders said.
